assets.name: loading-adventure
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-screen vertical mobile game loading BACKGROUND for 快乐萌宠消, design aspect 720:1560 (very tall portrait, about 1:2.17). Image 1 is ONLY a layout and art-direction reference: full illustrated cheerful game splash, pastel sunset sky at top, scene in lower half, book-filled foreground. Images 2 and 3 are our original cat and bunny mascot references, preserve their recognizable colors and friendly faces. Create a NEW original cohesive illustration: a happy white rabbit, a cyan kitten, and a little yellow chick sail together in a rounded golden wooden storybook boat on calm aqua water, discovering a magical storybook island. The rabbit cheerfully holds the wheel; the kitten looks ahead; the chick waves a tiny paw flag with no letters. Rounded tropical green leaves frame both sides; whimsical paper planes and a few floating pages connect the sky and water. Colorful closed and open storybooks form the foreground at the bottom. Warm pink/lavender sunset clouds at the top transition to luminous buttery yellow in the middle and turquoise water below. All characters and boat are in the lower half (roughly y=55% to 82%), fully visible. IMPORTANT: leave the upper 15%-40% as relatively calm soft sky for a separate game title that our app overlays; keep a quieter horizontal zone at 83% for a separately drawn loading bar and a readable lower margin. Bright polished 2D cartoon mobile game illustration, bold clean warm outlines, playful shapes, soft shading, no photorealism. This is background artwork only: absolutely no text, no title, no logo, no progress bar, no age-rating badge, no phone controls, no watermark. Fill the entire tall portrait frame edge to edge.

assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create the final static opening splash poster for our game. Image 1 is the background EDIT TARGET; preserve its very tall portrait aspect ratio, sunset colors, tropical leaves, book island, and bottom boat with rabbit, blue kitten, and yellow chick, without cropping away the scene. Image 2 is the exact existing game logo to INSERT, preserving its appearance and exact five-character text 快乐萌宠消. Place that logo centered in the upper sky area, occupying about 82% of poster width, with logo center at 24% of poster height. Keep the boat characters entirely unobstructed. No extra writing. No progress bar, no buttons, no age badge, no device controls, no additional watermark. Match the existing crisp colorful cartoon illustration; this is a careful composition of the two supplied assets, not a redesigned logo.
